401 Unauthorized error on stream initiation before any chunks are received

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "liter_llm.h"

int main(void) {
    const char* api_key = getenv("API_KEY");
    assert(api_key != NULL && "API_KEY must be set");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle chat_completion_request_handle = literllm_chat_completion_request_from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true}");
    assert(chat_completion_request_handle != 0 && "failed to build request");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle client = literllm_create_client(api_key, NULL, (uint64_t)-1, (uint32_t)-1, NULL);
    assert(client != 0 && "failed to create client");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle stream_handle = literllm_default_client_chat_stream_start(client, chat_completion_request_handle);
    if (stream_handle != 0) {
        while (1) {
            LITERLLMAlefHandle chunk = literllm_default_client_chat_stream_next(stream_handle);
            if (chunk == 0) {
                break;
            }
            literllm_chat_completion_chunk_free(chunk);
        }
    }
    assert(literllm_last_error_code() != 0 && "expected stream to fail");
    if (stream_handle != 0) {
        literllm_default_client_chat_stream_free(stream_handle);
    }
    literllm_chat_completion_request_free(chat_completion_request_handle);
    literllm_default_client_free(client);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
